# Rolling Sessions — Feature Documentation

## Overview

A **rolling session** is a Free Training session that stays open indefinitely instead of running a continuous timer. The user can leave the app, return later, tap the Free Training tile, and add more work to the same session at any time. There is no session duration clock — only the individual sets and blocks are tracked.

Rolling sessions differ from standard sessions in two key ways:

- **No duration display**: The session header omits the elapsed-time counter that appears for standard sessions.
- **Named time-stamped blocks**: Each time the user adds an exercise to an open rolling session from the home screen, a new segment block is created and named with the current wall-clock time (e.g., "3:45 PM"). This produces a chronological, labeled record of work across the day.

---

## User Workflow

```
HomeScreen
  └── Free Training tile
        └── _showFreeTrainingStartSheet (bottom sheet)
              ├── Rolling Session toggle (off by default)
              │     subtitle: "A rolling session stays open all day. Tap any tile
              │                to return and add more work at any time.
              │                No session timer — just your sets."
              └── Start Session button
                    └── WorkoutSessionScreen (isRolling = true/false)
```

---

## The `isRolling` Flag

| Detail | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Model field** | `TrainingSession.isRolling` |
| **Type** | `bool` |
| **Default** | `false` |
| **Persistence** | SQLite column `is_rolling` (integer 0/1) |
| **Set by** | `WorkoutState.createNewSession(isRolling: true/false)` |

The flag is set at session creation and is never mutated afterward. The Free Training start sheet (`_showFreeTrainingStartSheet` in `home_screen.dart`) exposes a `SwitchListTile` for the user to opt in before pressing **Start Session**.

---

## Named Time-Stamped Segment Blocks

When a rolling session is active and the user taps the **Free Training tile** to re-enter the session, the app navigates back to `WorkoutSessionScreen`. Exercises added to the session are grouped into `SessionBlock` records.

Each block is named with a human-readable timestamp automatically generated by `WorkoutState.addSessionBlock()`:

- Format: `"h:mm AM/PM"` (e.g., `"9:15 AM"`, `"3:45 PM"`)
- A new block is created each time a segment is added that contains exercises (for example, when the session is populated from a routine manifest, or when the user explicitly adds a new segment block).

Blocks are displayed in `WorkoutSessionScreen` sorted by `orderIndex`. This gives the session a chronological structure: each block represents a distinct training window within the same rolling day.

---

## UI Changes When `isRolling` Is True

| Element | Standard Session | Rolling Session |
|---------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Session duration counter | Visible in header | **Hidden** (`isRolling` suppresses it) |
| Segment blocks | Present if session has multiple segments | Present; named by time |
| Finish / Done flow | Empty sessions discard immediately and return to HomeScreen; non-empty sessions end with elapsed time recorded | Empty sessions discard immediately and return to HomeScreen; non-empty sessions end the rolling session and set `endedAtMs` on explicit finish |

The duration suppression is handled inline in `WorkoutSessionScreen`:

```dart
// Duration intentionally omitted for rolling sessions (Task 5).
```

The session still records `startedAtMs` and `endedAtMs` for archival purposes; only the live display is suppressed.

---

## Free Training Start Sheet (Inline Onboarding)

When the user taps the **Free Training tile**, `HomeScreen` shows `_showFreeTrainingStartSheet` — a modal bottom sheet that contains:

- A `SwitchListTile` labeled **Rolling Session** (default off)
- An inline subtitle explaining rolling behavior: *"A rolling session stays open all day. Tap any tile to return and add more work at any time. No session timer — just your sets."*
- A **Start Session** filled button

There is no separate first-time-only sheet. The guidance text is always visible in the Free Training start sheet. The `Don't show again` preference flow and a separate rolling onboarding modal were intentionally removed; all guidance was consolidated here.

---

## Entry Point

Rolling sessions are only available via the **Free Training tile** on `HomeScreen`. No other modality tile offers this option. The toggle is presented every time the sheet opens — it is not hidden after first use.

When an active rolling session exists and the user taps the Free Training tile, the app navigates directly back to `WorkoutSessionScreen` without showing a conflict dialog (because all modality tiles can legitimately log exercises into a rolling session).

If the user finishes a Free Training session before logging any exercises, the app discards that empty session and pops back to `HomeScreen` immediately. No confirmation dialog or summary screen is shown for empty Free Training sessions.

---

## WorkoutState API Surface

| Member | Kind | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `isRollingSession` | `bool` getter | Returns `true` when the active session has `isRolling == true`; returns `false` if no session is loaded |
| `createNewSession({..., bool isRolling = false, ...})` | async method | Creates a new session; the `isRolling` named parameter (bool, default `false`) sets `TrainingSession.isRolling` |
| `addSessionBlock({String? name})` | async method | Creates a named `SessionBlock` for the current session. If `name` is omitted, the block is named with the current wall-clock time in `"h:mm AM/PM"` format — the mechanism behind time-stamped blocks in rolling sessions |
| `getSessionBlocks()` | method | Returns blocks for the current session sorted by `orderIndex` |
